"""Serve unchanged generated bytes with browser-enforced scripting disabled."""
import argparse
from functools import partial
from http.server import SimpleHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument('directory')
ap.add_argument('--port', type=int, default=8768)
args = ap.parse_args()

class Scriptless(SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def end_headers(self):
        # CSP sandbox without allow-scripts disables scripting in this document;
        # script-src also blocks all inline/external script loading. No HTML edits.
        self.send_header('Content-Security-Policy', "sandbox allow-same-origin allow-popups allow-top-navigation; script-src 'none'")
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        super().end_headers()

print('Serving exact document bytes with scripting sandboxed off', flush=True)
ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', args.port), partial(Scriptless, directory=args.directory)).serve_forever()
